plazas.name: Plaza Tol Bukit Jelutong
osm_names: Lorong Tol Berlapis GCE Bukit Jelutong
plazas.note: Open system, charged at each GCE plaza crossed. Prolintas site lists RM1.75 (rate cut 20 Oct 2022 from RM1.90; OSM charge tag 1.90 is outdated). No class-0 row in the Prolintas table; motorcycles not charged (GCE has dedicated motorcycle lanes). 'Lorong Tol Berlapis' is the fishbone booth extension of the same plaza (northbound link). Mainline plaza, booths on both carriageways in OSM.

plazas.name: Plaza Tol Elmina
plazas.note: Open system, charged at each GCE plaza crossed. Prolintas site lists RM1.75 (rate cut 20 Oct 2022 from RM1.90; OSM charge tag 1.90 is outdated). No class-0 row in the Prolintas table; motorcycles not charged (GCE has dedicated motorcycle lanes). Prolintas lists north- and southbound lanes.

plazas.name: Plaza Tol Lagong
plazas.note: Open system, charged at each GCE plaza crossed. Prolintas site lists RM1.75 (rate cut 20 Oct 2022 from RM1.90; OSM charge tag 1.90 is outdated). No class-0 row in the Prolintas table; motorcycles not charged (GCE has dedicated motorcycle lanes). Prolintas lists north- and southbound lanes. Note: 'Plaza Tol Rawang Selatan' (OSM, E35 tag) is NOT a GCE plaza - it is the PLUS NSE closed-system gate at the GCE/NSE junction; GCE has exactly 3 plazas.

plazas.name: Plaza Tol Seri Muda
plazas.note: Open system mainline plaza; Prolintas lists TnG lanes for both City Centre and Kota Kemuning bounds. OSM tag 1.70 is pre-Oct-2022. Motorcycles not charged.

plazas.name: Plaza Tol Alam Impian
osm_names: Plaza Tol LKSA Alam Impian (Arah Barat)
Plaza Tol LKSA Alam Impian (Arah Timur)
plazas.note: Ramp plaza at Exit 1303 (OSM booths on both the exit and the entry link); Prolintas lists lanes for both Alam Impian and City Centre bounds. OSM tag 0.90 is pre-Oct-2022. Motorcycles not charged.

plazas.name: Plaza Tol Jalan Datuk Keramat
plazas.note: AKLEH's only toll plaza (19 lanes); OSM has booths on both carriageways (bearings ~114 and ~293), so both directions pay. Motorcycles not charged.

plazas.name: Plaza Tol Denai Alam
plazas.note: DASH (opened toll 2022-12-01) has 3 plazas, each RM2.30 Class 1 (Prolintas page 'last updated 20 May 2024', same rate as at toll start). Motorcycles: not listed; treat as 0. Mainline plaza; OSM booth nodes on both carriageways (bearings ~81/263) -> both directions.

plazas.name: Plaza Tol RRIM (Kwasa Damansara)
plazas.note: DASH (opened toll 2022-12-01) has 3 plazas, each RM2.30 Class 1 (Prolintas page 'last updated 20 May 2024', same rate as at toll start). Motorcycles: not listed; treat as 0. Ramp-type plaza: OSM booth nodes sit on two motorway_link ramps (bearings ~137/~317), so it charges traffic using the RRIM ramps, not DASH through-traffic. Direction coverage inferred from OSM, not from an official statement.

plazas.name: Plaza Tol Kota Damansara (DASH)
plazas.note: DASH (opened toll 2022-12-01) has 3 plazas, each RM2.30 Class 1 (Prolintas page 'last updated 20 May 2024', same rate as at toll start). Motorcycles: not listed; treat as 0. Mainline plaza, OSM booth nodes on both carriageways (~76/~256). Do not confuse with OSM 'Plaza Tol Kota Damansara' (PLUS/NKVE, Persiaran Kenanga).

plazas.name: Plaza Tol Ijok
plazas.note: Mainline plaza, booths on both carriageways. LATAR is open-system; rates frozen for 2026 (govt list of 10 highways). Motorcycles free (class 0 'Free' per Wikipedia rate table; not shown on the official image).

plazas.name: Plaza Tol Kuang Barat
plazas.note: Official table groups 'Ijok, Kuang, Templer' at RM2.50. Kuang West is a WESTBOUND-ONLY mainline plaza (Wikipedia interchange list; OSM booth on the westbound carriageway, bearing ~261). LATAR is open-system; rates frozen for 2026 (govt list of 10 highways). Motorcycles free (class 0 'Free' per Wikipedia rate table; not shown on the official image).

plazas.name: Plaza Tol Kuang Timur
plazas.note: EASTBOUND-ONLY mainline plaza (Wikipedia; OSM booth on eastbound carriageway, bearing ~79). Official table says 'Kuang' = RM2.50; the OSM charge tag (RM1.30) conflicts and is treated as wrong. LATAR is open-system; rates frozen for 2026 (govt list of 10 highways). Motorcycles free (class 0 'Free' per Wikipedia rate table; not shown on the official image).

plazas.name: Plaza Tol Kundang Barat
plazas.note: Ramp plaza at Kundang interchange (Exit 2505). Wikipedia's rate table says 'Kundang (both directions)'; OSM has a booth node only on one ramp (bearing ~278) - assume entry and exit lanes both pay. LATAR is open-system; rates frozen for 2026 (govt list of 10 highways). Motorcycles free (class 0 'Free' per Wikipedia rate table; not shown on the official image).

plazas.name: Plaza Tol Kundang Timur
plazas.note: Ramp plaza at the other half of the Kundang interchange (OSM booth on ramp bearing ~88). Same caveat as Kundang Barat. LATAR is open-system; rates frozen for 2026 (govt list of 10 highways). Motorcycles free (class 0 'Free' per Wikipedia rate table; not shown on the official image).

plazas.name: Plaza Tol Taman Rimba Templer
osm_names: Plaza Tol Taman Rimba Templer (Arah Barat)
Plaza Tol Taman Rimba Templer (Arah Timur)
plazas.note: Mainline plaza, booths on both carriageways. LATAR is open-system; rates frozen for 2026 (govt list of 10 highways). Motorcycles free (class 0 'Free' per Wikipedia rate table; not shown on the official image).

plazas.name: Plaza Tol Eco Grandeur
plazas.note: NEW: Exit 2502 opened 2025-11-11 toll-free; toll collection began 2026-08-07. 10 lanes, 5 per direction (ramp plaza, OSM booths on both ramps). Motorcycles not listed (assume free). LATAR is open-system; rates frozen for 2026 (govt list of 10 highways). Motorcycles free (class 0 'Free' per Wikipedia rate table; not shown on the official image).

plazas.name: Plaza Tol Kapar (NNKSB mainline)
plazas.note: Mainline barrier plaza near Kapar I/C; OSM booths on both carriageways (~26/~205). NNKSB (Grand Sepadu) is open-system; rates frozen for 2026. Motorcycles free (Wikipedia rate table class 0 'Free'; official page lists classes 1-5 only).

plazas.name: Plaza Tol Kapar Laluan Barat (ramp)
plazas.note: Ramp plaza. Official rate depends on movement: RM1.40 'Kapar to Bukit Raja' (entering towards Bukit Raja), RM1.60 'Pelabuhan Klang to Kapar' (exiting after coming from Port Klang). OSM operator tag 'Grand Sepadu' confirms this is the old Kapar ramp plaza. Which OSM ramp node maps to which movement is not verified. NNKSB (Grand Sepadu) is open-system; rates frozen for 2026. Motorcycles free (Wikipedia rate table class 0 'Free'; official page lists classes 1-5 only).

plazas.name: Plaza Tol Kapar Laluan Timur (ramp)
plazas.note: Ramp plaza; same two movement rates as Laluan Barat (RM1.40 Kapar->Bukit Raja, RM1.60 Pelabuhan Klang->Kapar). OSM booth nodes on two ramps (~23/~201). NNKSB (Grand Sepadu) is open-system; rates frozen for 2026. Motorcycles free (Wikipedia rate table class 0 'Free'; official page lists classes 1-5 only).

plazas.name: Plaza Tol Bukit Raja (NNKSB)
plazas.note: Rate is official (RM0.60 Class 1), but location is NOT verified: the only OSM candidate 'Plaza Tol Bukit Raja' is tagged operator PLUS and refs E1;E30, i.e. it may be the NKVE (PLUS) closed-system terminal plaza. Do not double-charge: check on the map before using. NNKSB (Grand Sepadu) is open-system; rates frozen for 2026. Motorcycles free (Wikipedia rate table class 0 'Free'; official page lists classes 1-5 only).

plazas.name: Plaza Tol Gombak
plazas.note: Barrier plaza, OSM booths on both carriageways (~78 eastbound, ~270 westbound) - charged both directions. KL-Karak is open system, rates unchanged since 2015-10-15. Motorcycles free (Wikipedia class 0). Concessionaire ANIH Berhad is now AFA Prime Berhad; the old anihberhad.com domain now redirects to an unrelated Indonesian site - do not use it.

plazas.name: Plaza Tol Bentong
plazas.note: Barrier plaza, OSM booths on both carriageways (~23 and ~200) - charged both directions. KL-Karak is open system, rates unchanged since 2015-10-15. Motorcycles free (Wikipedia class 0). Concessionaire ANIH Berhad is now AFA Prime Berhad; the old anihberhad.com domain now redirects to an unrelated Indonesian site - do not use it.

plazas.name: Genting Highlands Entry (Genting Sempah)
plazas.note: Real, charging. Charged only when entering (uphill). OSM booth on the one-way uphill carriageway, bearing ~45-59. Private road (Jalan Genting Highlands) operated by Lingkaran Cekap Sdn Bhd (LCSB); road charge started 2026-05-28 after a no-charge trial from 2026-04-02. Class 1 RM5.00 per ENTRY; motorcycles, emergency vehicles and listed public servants exempt; registered residents (from 2026-06-28) pay 10% less. Not an LLM-gazetted highway toll.

plazas.name: Gohtong Jaya Entry
plazas.note: Real, charging at the Gohtong Jaya roundabout entry. Entry-only; heading taken from the OSM one-way way through the booth (~160-167) and not independently verified. Private road (Jalan Genting Highlands) operated by Lingkaran Cekap Sdn Bhd (LCSB); road charge started 2026-05-28 after a no-charge trial from 2026-04-02. Class 1 RM5.00 per ENTRY; motorcycles, emergency vehicles and listed public servants exempt; registered residents (from 2026-06-28) pay 10% less. Not an LLM-gazetted highway toll.

closed.confidence: high for WCE pairs, medium for SKVE-only pairs
closed.note: Closed system: take ticket/tap at entry gate, pay at exit gate; WCE says fares are the same in both directions. WCE S1 (Banting-SKVE) tolled from 2024-09-30; S2 (SKVE-SAE) tolled from 2025-06-13; both integrated with SKVE at Tanjung Dua Belas I/C (no gate there). LLM notice 2024-08-30 confirms AH->Banting = SKVE RM3.92 + WCE RM2.34 = RM6.26. SKVE east section from Ayer Hitam plaza to UNITEN (section 1A) is toll-free; no SKVE gate exists east of Ayer Hitam. 'Plaza Tol Bandar Saujana Putra' (OSM, PLUS) is an ELITE gate, NOT SKVE. Wikipedia lists a 'Pulau Carey' (PCY) toll booth on SKVE - not in any official fare table found, unverified. Motorcycles free on SKVE (Wikipedia); WCE motorcycle status not stated officially (assumed free). OSM '(unnamed 3.01,101.49)' booths sit on a highway=construction way = future WCE Section 3 plaza (S3 opening expected Q1 2027), no fare yet. Rates frozen for 2026 for SKVE.

closed.name: WCE Sections 5-6 (Bandar Bukit Raja - Assam Jawa)
closed.note: Official WCE fare table/image. Assam Jawa tolled since 2024-01-03 (Section 6 opened 2023-11-21). BBS gate matched to OSM 'Plaza Tol NNKSB2': its booth nodes are on ramps right next to the OSM junction node 'Bandar Bukit Raja Selatan' (exit 3207) - name in OSM is misleading. WCE Section 4 (NKVE/FHR2 - NNKSB) was reported to open 2026-03-18 but WCE's own FAQ still lists it as under construction; no Section 4 gate/fare appears in WCE's fare data. Assam Jawa plaza is tagged E25 in OSM because WCE meets the LATAR alignment there. Section 7 (Assam Jawa - Hutan Melintang/Tanjong Karang) not open.

closed.note: Official WCE fare data embedded in wce.com.my/toll-rates (fareData object). Sections 9-10 opened 2019-09-23, Section 11 (Beruas-Taiping Selatan) 2024-03-12. Note Kg Lekir and Sitiawan/Taiping pairs are not distance-linear (e.g. Trong->Taiping Selatan RM1.88) - use the table, not interpolation.
